metadata.case_name: WONG HEUNG WING WINGO v. JOHNSON CLEANING SERVICES CO LTD AND ANOTHER

source: he had renal failure before the accident.
According to Dr Kwok, despite all the urological care Wong had received, his kidney function continued to deteriorate.

Since June 2014, Wong had to receive haemodialysis twice a week. That was changed to daily abdominal peritoneal dialysis in January 2015, which Wong can perform by himself. Such dialysis is required 4 times every day.

injuries.description: contracted bladder requiring augmentation with a piece of small bowel and intermittent self-catheterization
source: his bladder was found to be very constricted. As a result, his bladder capacity had to be augmented with a piece of small bowel by open surgery.
Wong also had a contracted bladder which required him to preform intermittent self-catheterization to relieve himself.
Finally, Wong also suffered from severe impairment of liver function.
Wong was severely anaemic on the day of the accident.
the hospital record shows that he required a transfusion on the next day, 22 March 2010.
Subsequent investigation found that Wong was suffering from gastritis and severe iron deficiency anaemia.
Wong also suffered from serum electrolyte imbalance.
investigation found that Wong was suffering from gastritis, which was treated with medication.
During hospitalisation, the anaemia was investigated with upper gastrointestinal endoscopy on 9 April 2010 with diagnosis of gastritis, which was treated with medication.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: fracture of the left proximal humerus
source: Wong suffered from fracture of the left proximal humerus and fracture of the left hip.
The left proximal humerus was treated conservatively.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of humerus

source: Wong suffered from fracture of the left proximal humerus and fracture of the left hip.
Wong had surgery performed on his hip (dynamic hip screw fixation) on 25 March 2010.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of unspecified trochanteric section of femur

source: On 17 July 2010, Wong was again admitted into Hospital because of jaundice, severe anaemia and acute chronic renal failure. He had to be transferred to intensive care for renal support. He was put on temporary dialysis (apparently he was not fit for haemodialysis) and was found to have septicaemia.

manifestations.description: dizziness, headache, vertigo, tinnitus, fatigue, exertional dyspnea, tachycardia, palpitation, angina, nausea, loss of appetite, constipation or diarrhoea (as possible symptoms of severe anaemia)
residual pain in the left hip region
residual pain in the left shoulder region
mild residual tenderness over the left hip region
residual weakness in his left leg which might hinder heavy lifting

treatments_received: dynamic hip screw fixation on 25 March 2010
upper gastrointestinal endoscopy on 9 April 2010 with diagnosis of gastritis
haemodialysis twice a week since June 2014
daily abdominal peritoneal dialysis since January 2015 (performed by himself, required 4 times every day)

losses.description: Damages for pain suffering and loss of amenities agreed at HK$215,000 (pain, suffering and loss of amenities)
residual weakness in his left leg which might hinder heavy lifting and give a substantial disadvantage in the labour market
